config.description: Small integration boundary: ordinary control supplies desired profiles; this module owns execution and filters writes to effect-owned lamps.

variables.assignments: {% set n=namespace(a={}) %}{% for L,a in (state_attr('sensor.effects_controller','assignments') or {}).items() if L not in profiles %}{% set n.a=dict(n.a,**{L:a}) %}{% endfor %}{% for L,p in profiles.items() if p.effect in catalog.effects and p.on %}{% set n.a=dict(n.a,**{L:{'effect':p.effect,'brightness':p.brightness}}) %}{% endfor %}{{ n.a }}
